segments.comment: A debug Valkyrie creates the Wizard of Yendor and slays him with #wizkill, which makes her a demigod and starts the intervention countdown. She creates a second Wizard, sends him off the level with #migratemons -1, and fills every free square with 1000 peaceful brown molds. During a long counted search, wizard.c intervene() picks resurrect(), which takes the migrating Wizard to dog.c mon_arrive(Wiz_arrive): mnearto() finds no room beside her, so mon_arrive() calls mon.c m_into_limbo() and the Wizard migrates back to this level. #migratemons then lists him as pending for the current level. Seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
